tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// bhadrabirūpauḥpratibim+baṃdeshanas+yādar+shanāmakāladūtirnabodayawar+ṣ+yakaraṇas+sid+dhaush+tsagaṇitas+yaṛthubiharatisma//

༄༅// dus kyi pho nya gsar tshes kyi gnam lo'i byed grub rtsis kyi li'u tho bzang ngan gzugs brnyan ston pa'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta skye 'gro la prāstā ra bzhi stong go drug mchis pa yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba nyi ma rjes 'brangs bcas/ yi ge bzhi khri rjes 'brangs bcas/ lci yang so so nyi khri rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo bdun khri rjes 'brangs bcas/ a dh+wa 'phred rtse mo lag pa/ steng 'og brgyad stong rjes 'brangs bcas/ khyad par ud+diṣ+ṭa chig stong rjes 'brangs bcas naṣ+ṭa re pa bzhi pa me tog phreng can zhes bya bas mdzes par spras pa'o// ༄༅// dhar+m+madhātuḥprapañtsash+tsanan+tapriyābikṛḍebhiḥpraṇītas+sukhānāṃrasaṃ/ māritaṃdhātushān+taubhawāriyugaukālatsakreṇahīpālayashrīguruḥ ༄༅// chos dbyings spros pa'i mtha' bral dga' ma dang*// gya nom bde ba'i ro la rnam rtsen pas// srid zhi'i dgra bo zung 'jug dbyings su bsad// dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor los skyongs// dus gsum rtog pa'i dgra sde shes rab kyis// dus med dbyings su bsgral yang smon lam mthus// dus mkhyen sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mkhan// dus dgra'i mgon po dang po'i sangs rgyas 'dud// sgron me'i bskal bzang rnam 'dren thams cad las// thugs bskyed rmad byung bsod nams ye shes tshogs// yongs rdzogs phan bde'i dgos 'dod 'dzad pa med// 'byung gnas bstan pa'i byed po shāṃkyaṃ'i sras// bcu drug lang tsho dar bab mtshan dpe'i sku// mthong na mi mthun med pa 'char ka'i nyis// lan brgyar 'khyud pa'i mtshams sprin gsar pa las// blangs pa ltar mdzes 'jamaṃ dpaṃl rdoṃ rjeṃs skyongs// rgyal kun mkhyen rab rang bzhin mtshar sdug gar// dran tsam 'phral la rmongs pa ring bcom ste// shes bya'i gnas la 'jigs bral blo gros dang*// ngag gi dbang phyug mchog sbyin dbyangaṃs canaṃ lha// thub dbang 'jig rten mes po'i thod yangs nas// gsang rgyud mtho ris klung chen gang thugs kyi// bde 'byung ral pa'i khrod 'ching zlaṃ bzaṃng dang*// lhaṃ dbang la sogs chos rgyal rnams la dad// phyi nang gzhan gsum ston pa'i rgyud chen gzugs// mkhyen dpyod bzhin snod gtsang mar shar ba'i 'gyur// mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir 'gyings chos kyi sgra// 'gag med glu len rigaṃ ldanaṃ nyiṃ shuṃ lngaṃ// mi dman thugs bskyed shugs ldan tu raṅgas// rnam 'byed shes rab gom stabs stong bsgyur te// gsang chen rgyud kyi rin chen spungs pa'i khur// sham+bha la nas 'dren mdzad tsiṃ luṃ paṃ// mkhyen rab lang tshos sgeg pa'i zur mig gis// rtogs dka'i rgyud don khengs ldan snying gi grogs// bkug ste 'phags pa'i yul dang ljongs 'di ru// dgyes dgur spyod mdzad loṃ paṃṇa rnam thar bsams// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas rin chen sgo 'phar stong*// yongs 'byed ngag gi dngos grub kuṃñdziṃ kaḥ// ngagaṃ dbaṃng lha mo'i legs byin tshul 'di la// bka' drin rmad byung suṃ dhīṃḥsaṃ gaṃ raṃ// mkhyen brtse nus pa chen pos bdag rgyud kyi// rmongs tshogs bsal te che chung rig pa'i gnas// dpyod pa'i blo gros mchog ster bka' drin stobs// zla med sloṃb dpoṃn mkhaṃs pa gtsug gis bsten// thar pa thams cad mkhyen gnyis sgrib pa'i g.ya'// ma zad de srid blo yi ma gu ras// phra zhib shes bya'i ngo mtshar ltad mo'i gzugs// gsal bar ston pa'i yoṃn tanaṃ lkog na mo// 'on te 'phaṃgs paṃ'i blo mchog mkha' lding gis// spyod rjes rang gzhan rtog pa spel ba'i phyir// slob pa de la gshe rnams tshe rabs sngon// byol song sgrub pa'i thabs la goms pas len// 'di na byedaṃ grubaṃ rtsiṃs kyi rjes 'brang ba'i// gsar tshes gnam lo'i li'u tho 'god pa'i sngon// 'bras bshad dpyid kyi dpal mo'i rgyang glu yis// ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dbyar skyes mdza' bo dgug

/de 'dir rang re lha mir bcas pa yi// 'dren pa mtshungs med stobs sogs yon tan dang*// thugs rje'i gting mtha' kun gsal yangs pas kyang*// 'gran par dka' ba'i skye sngon dmaṃ paṃ togaṃ /dga' ldan gnas nas gzigs pa rnam lnga yis// mdzes sdug sgyu 'phrul lhums su gnyis 'thung dbang*// mche ba drug ldan rnam pas zhugs nas bzung*// ngos lhag zhag gi phung po dgu 'das pa'i// drag po lcags sprel sa ga zla ba yi// tshes bdun lum+bi'i tshal du bltams nas lo// nyis stong dag dang drug brgya go brgyad 'das// gang de'i smra sgo'i me tog 'dzum dbus nas// gsang rgyud rgyal po'i sbrang rtsi'i bcud len gyi// dga' ston dpa' bo lcags 'brug nag pa nyar// sham+bha la yi grong khyer bye ba phrag /dgu bcu rtsa drug dbang bsgyur zlaṃ baṃ bzaṃng*// gtsos pa'i skal ldan 'gro la stsal nas lo// nyis stong drug brgya bco brgyad sngon du 'das// shing sprel dha na ko sha'i rgya mtsho'i gling*// lo 'dab gos bzang pad+ma'i khang bzang dbus// snang stong 'ja' lus pad+maṃ saṃm+bhaṃ waṃ// ngo mtshar khye'u chung brdzus te bltams nas lo// nyis stong drug brgya bcu bzhi sngon du brgal// shing byir tha snyad bden pa'i gtsug lag gis// ma hā tsi na'i lus can 'dul dgongs nas// ri bo rtse lnga tri k+ṣa'i shing lba las// 'jaṃm dpaṃl rdoṃ rjeṃ brdzus te bltams nas lo// bgrang gzhi nyis stong lnga brgya don bzhi 'das// drag po lcags sprel mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam// gsal byed rgyal ba'i zhal las lung bstan gyi// bdud rtsi nod pa'i 'phaṃgs paṃ kluṃ sgrubaṃ zhabs// bltams nas nyis stong nyis brgya bco brgyad brgal// shing byir bod yul chos kyi rgyal po yi// thog ma thoṃ riṃ gnyenaṃ btsaṃn 'khrungs nas lo// stong dang bzhi brgya gya bzhi chu mo sbrul// gangs can yul grur 'khod pa'i lus can gyi// dam chos bgo skal gnyen po gsang ba'i mdoṃ// babs te dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes nas// bgrang bya chig stong bzhi brgya nyag ma lnga// sa glang bo ṭa'i yul gyi gdul bya la// snying rje'i mchi ma cher 'khrugs ma bzod shugs// 'phags mchog phyagaṃ naṃ pad+maṃ sa dbang gi

/gar mkhan rol pa srongaṃ btsanaṃ sgaṃm poṃ gang*// bltams nas stong dang chig brgya dgu lhag 'das// 'jam dpal gzhon nus legs gsungs dus gsum gyi// legs nyes ston pa'i mngon shes rtsis kyi mdzod// rgya nag yul nas 'unaṃ shiṃng koṃng joṃ yis// spyan drangs pur rgyal bod du phebs nas lo// chig stong dang ni go bdun sngon du brgal// chu glang lhaṃ ldanaṃ spruṃl pa'i gtsug lag khang*// bzhengs nas stong phrag gcig dang gya lnga 'das// lcags rta 'jam dpal sa la spyod pa'i gar// khriṃ sroṃng bltams nas stong la brgyad kyis brgyan// lcags yos zaṃn g.yaṃng miṃ 'gyuraṃ gaṃtsug laṃg khaṃng*// bzhengs nas bgrang gzhi dgu brgya gya bdun 'das// chu rtar chos rgyal dge ba dpal gyi sras// khab nas mngon byung mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag /mngon gyur sgrol mas lung bstan bod kyi yul// byon te bka' gdams bstan pa'i lugs srol gyi// byed po dīṃ paṃ kaṃ raṃ 'khrungs nas bzung*// bgrang gzhi bdun brgya nga drug sngon du 'das// shing lug pad dkar 'dzin pa 'gro 'dul gar// legs bsgyur ma 'dris 'gro la mdza' ba'i bshes// 'broṃm rjeṃ rgyalaṃ ba'iṃ 'byung gnas 'khrungs pa nas// bgrang gzhi bdun brgya so bzhi bcas pa 'das// me yos thabs shes gnyis med rgyud kyi rgyal// dpal mchog kāṃ laṃ tsaṃ kraṃ bod yul ljongs// spyan 'dren mdzad nas bgrang gzhi bdun brgya dang*// nyag ma bcu gcig sngon 'das me bya lor// mthong na 'gro rgyud las nyon dri ma'i tshogs// 'khrud pa'i byin rlabs drang srong dza hu'i rgyun// mar me mdzad kyi zhal lung bka' gdams kyi// gzhung gis rab bsngags rwaṃ sgreṃng dben pa'i gnas// btab nas brgya phrag drug dang gya gcig 'das// chu glang rigs gsum rnam 'phrul 'od gsal gdung*// rim bzhin byon dang 'byon 'gyur gdan sa che// gsang sngags chos 'byung dpaṃl ldaṃn saṃ skyaṃ zhes// grags pa'i rol mo mkhan 'di btab nas bzung*// drug brgya re bzhi sngon 'das chu pho sprel// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dpal ldan bi rū pas// byin brlabs shes bya kun la mi 'jigs pa// blo gros dbang phyug nges don he ru kaḥ

/sa chen kunaṃ dgaṃ' snyingaṃ poṃ bltams nas lo// drug brgya zhe drug sngon brgal chu stag la// mkhyen dpyod nyin mor byed pa'i gzi stong gis// smra ngan 'byung po'i 'dab ldan mi smra'i rgyar// nyer bcing yang dag bstan pa'i pad tshal kha// 'byed pa'i gnyen gcig sa skya paṃṇa chenaṃ zhes// grags pa'i rnga gsang phyogs kyi lus phra yis// brdung de bltams nas lnga brgya nga drug brgal// shing lug gnam bskos gong ma'i rigs kyi bdag /bod khams yongs kyi phan bde'i byed pa por// bla med dbang gi mnga' gsol 'gro ba'i mgon// 'phags mchog bloṃ groṃs rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn 'khrungs nas lo// brgya phrag lnga dang nyag ma gsum bcas yol// lcags stag mkhyen rab rdo rje pha lam gyis// ji snyed shes bya'i nor bu sra mkhregs khams// thogs med 'bigs pa buṃ stonaṃ riṃn cheṃn grubaṃ// 'khrungs nas bgrang gzhi bzhi brgya zhe brgyad brgal// me mo bya lo mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam// smra la 'jigs bral blo gros 'dab brgya'i kha// 'jam dpal rdo rjes legs phye bloṃ bzaṃng graṃgs// gser zhun cod paṇa 'chang de bltams nas lo// brgya phrag gsum dang gya gcig sngon du brgal// lcags lug mngon rjes tshad ma'i rigs lung smrar// zla med thams cad gzigs pa dgeṃ 'duṃn grubaṃ// bltams nas sum brgya zhe bdun lhag ma can// sa glang 'jam mgon bla ma btsoṃng khaṃ paṃs// 'gro kun bsod nams tshogs mthar phyin pa'i ched// thub pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar cho 'phrul gyi// dus chen smon lam tshugs dang ma pham pa'i// bsti gnas sa la 'phos 'dra dgaṃ' ldanaṃ gyi// chos sde btab nas sum brgya don bzhi 'das// me sprel thub dbang lugs mchog bsam 'phel dbang*// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor mnga' gsol ba'i// bstan 'dzin dge 'dun bsti gnas 'brasaṃ spungaṃ gi /chos sde zhes grags snyan pa'i ru mtshon ni// srid rtser snyegs pa 'di nyid btab nas lo// sum brgya nyer gnyis 'das shing sa phag lor// lus can phan bde'i rtsa lag dam chos kyi// sgra dbyangs chad med sgrogs pa'i rigs grol sdes// yongs gang seṃ raṃ thegaṃ chenaṃ chos kyi gling*// btab nas brgya phrag gsum dang bco lnga 'das// chu yos rab 'byams rig pa'i gzhung lugs rtsis// mtha' dag mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo las// 'dren la bsnyengs bral noraṃ bzaṃng rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i zhabs// bltams nas sum brgya bco lnga bgrang gzhi 'das// sa byar rnam gsum sdom ldan bstan 'dzin gyis// gsang sngags bstan pa'i bshad sgrub bskal pa'i yun// spel ba'i chos grwa badz+ra ā sa na// gnyis pa eṃ waṃ chosaṃ kyiṃ 'byungaṃ gnaṃs che// btab nas brgya phrag gsum dang dgu 'das shing*// me yos bslab gsum khrims gtsang 'dus pa'i sdes// sde snod bshad sgrub rgyalaṃ mtshanaṃ srid rtse'i bar// mthoṃn poṃr 'degs pa'i bkra shis lhun po zhes// chos sde chen po btab nas nyis brgya dang*// go gcig sngon 'das me sprel dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba'i thugs rjeṃ gcig bsdus thams cad mkhyen// dgeṃ 'duṃn rgyaṃ mtshoṃ 'khrungs nas nyis brgya dang*// re gnyis sngon 'das chu yos theg chen gyi// bstan pa'i gnyen gyur puṃ ṇ+ya saṃ muṃ draḥ

/'khrungs nas chig brgya dang ni go lnga 'das// sa glang khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /rgyal dbang yoṃn tanaṃ rgyaṃ mtshoṃ 'khrungs nas lo// brgya dang zhe dgu sngon 'das me mo sbrul// snying rje chen po'i gter chen pad dkar 'chang*// gru 'dzin zhing las ma g.yos smon lam mthus// sgyu 'phrul rol pa ma 'gags sprul pa'i gar// shes bya thamaṃs cadaṃ mkhyeṃn paṃ ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng*// bloṃ bzaṃng rgyaṃ mtshoṃ 'khrungs nas bgrang ba'i gzhi// brgya phrag gcig dang nyer gcig sngon du yol// rab byung nyi ma'i grangs son me mo yos// shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i sgo 'phar 'bum// 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod gser gyi lde'u mig dag /'jam dpal gzhon nus byin pa sa yi bdag /buṃd+dhaṃ aṃp+tisaṃ skar nag rtsis kyi gzhung*// bstan bcos bai ḍūr dkar po brtsams nas lo// lnga bcu rtsa gcig sngon 'das shing mo sbrul// bde gshegs rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal// rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smrig 'chang gi gar// thams cad mkhyen pa tshulaṃ khrimaṃs lhunaṃ gyis grubaṃ// e waṃ yi ges nyer mtshan chos kyi khrir// 'khor 'das shis pa'i dbyangs snyan 'bum phrag gis// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol nas// bgrang gzhi nyer dgu brgal ba'i gsar tshes lo// rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur las 'phos pa// legs sbyar skad du kāṃ laṃ dūṃ tiṃ zhes// bod brdar bsgyur la dusaṃ kyiṃ phoṃ nyaraṃ brjod// ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab wuṃ wuṃ zhes// dbang thang 'byung khams dang mthun saṃ phoṃ rtaṃ// 'byung ba bzhi ldan se zhig speṃn paṃ'i klungaṃ*// pho brang gling dgu'i lte bar dbang sgyur lha// sman gyi me long zhes byas rnam par rtsen// rnam dag grub pa'i lo gza' snaṃ tshogaṃs 'od// lo yi skar ma lhaṃ yiṃ dbangaṃ ldan noṃ// bsdus rgyud byed pa'i lo 'pho rgyaṃ mtshoṃ skyesaṃ// lo stod dbang bsgyur rgyal po gnyis skyes dbang*// bka' yi 'khor bsgyur blon chen me rigs skyes// zab zab dam pa'i don du bya byed las// dngos dngos bden pas stong yang kun rdzob tu// rim rim lo dang gza' skar 'pho 'gyur gyi// mang mang 'gro la bde sdug 'di ltar ston/

༈ /phugaṃ lugs lo gza' 'di la sbrang char dkon// lo tog 'bring la srog chags lo thog gzan// dud 'gro nad gtser nyi zla'i 'od zer dman// sman gyi mthu chung skya rgyal 'khrug pa dang*// 'on kyang dmangs rigs skye bo bde bar gleng*// loṃ skaraṃ 'brasaṃ buṃ bshes gnyen dam pa dang*// rigs bzang bde zhing 'gro ba'i longs spyod 'phel// sems can khams spyir bde skyid 'byung ba dang*// lo legs chos spyod 'ga' zhig bro 'tshal gsungs// byedaṃ paṃ loṃ 'phoṃs char 'bebs sman bcud spel// nags tshal me tog chu klung lteng ka dang*// bzhon rnams 'o ma mang 'phel mi bdag gis// yul 'khor byams pas skyong zhing gzhon nu rtse// loṃ stod rgyal po char 'bab 'bru tshogs 'phel// gzhon nu rtse zhing bzhon ma'i 'o ma mang*// de yi 'phrul blon chos ldan grags pa 'thob// mchod sbyin rta dang gnyis 'thung ba lang 'phel// blo ldan rig pa rgyas 'gyur nam mkha' las// sprin bcud dus su babs pas 'bru sogs rgyas// rtaṃ yiṃ loṃ 'diṃr rgyal khams 'khrug pa bdo// phyugs nyes bkres 'grangs mi snyoms dbyar stod than// gro nas 'bru skyon can 'byung gnam dmag g.yo// so zar 'bring la gshongs zhing cung zad nyes// rlung chen ldang zhing nad rims che phra mang*// dgu gling dbus zhugs snying po yul khams su// rims dang 'khrug pa cher 'byung mi 'bru snyi// chu bo rab rgyas yul gyi 'pho 'gyur mang*// nai pa la yul mkhas pa'i legs bshad las// rlung 'phel 'bru dang bsil ba'i reg bya rab// char rgyun drod kyi gdung ba 'khrug pa 'bring*// dbyar skyes rtswa ljang zad pa tha ma'o// shaṃ kaṃ'i 'daṃs loṃ drag pos sbyangs pa'i lhag /gzugs shar rdzing bur 'jug ces then pa 'byung*// de sogs 'bras bu bsdu tshe 'bring rab mngon// saṃ rtaṃ'i loṃ 'dir dus bstan me long las// snga then phyugs nyes lo legs sad phran 'byung*// drang srong lha yi bla ma'i drug cu'i 'bras// dpyid sos char nyung dbyar ston char pa che// lo legs mi rnams nad kyis mi bder byed// mdo sde gsang bar sos then so zar brtson// gro dang dkar mo rgyas 'gyur sad kyang 'byung*// gnag 'bring khre nyes rims nad khol bu 'ong*// rgya nag stag rnar snga then phyis zhod la// lo 'bring yul 'khrug phyugs nyes bkres ltogs 'byung*// deṃ ltaṃr 'groṃ seṃms rang bzhin rnam dag gshis// 'pho 'gyur med kyang sngon las dge sdig dang*// lo gza' la sogs dgra grogs phrad pa'i tshe// bde sdug sna tshogs myong 'di rten 'brel chos// bdaṃg bloṃ pho nya'i dri mchog bzhon pa la// nyer bskyon mkhas pa'i lung gi dga' tshal las// mgyogs par btus pa'i mngon shes rtsis kyi mdzod// a mra'i 'bras bu smin legs de tsam mo// skyesaṃ sbyangaṃs shesaṃ raṃb bdag pos ma bzung bar// bdag blo'i zhing sa snyom las gor ma'i khrod// rig gnas sa bon btab kyang legs bshad kyi// myu gu ma smin skyon snang mkhas la bshags// tshulaṃ 'diṃr 'bad pa'i legs byas kha lo pas// rgyal bstan nyi ma gangs can mkha' dkyil du// ches cher bdo ba'i byin rlabs 'od stong gis// phan bde'i chu skyes grangs med dgod par shog

/grangs med skye ba'i mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro// ma rig gnyid la yur rnams chos kyi sgras// nyer bslang ngo mtshar shes bya'i ltad mo 'bum// ston byed thams cad mkhyen pa mngon 'gyur shog /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khongs 'khod lus can kun// kun 'byung rgyur bcas sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*// zhing gi dam pa dkon mchog yon tan dran// dran shes bag yod spyod tshul skyong bar shog /dam pa'i chosaṃ la legs spyod bsod nams kyi// 'khoṃr lo sngon du bgrod ldan saṃ gzhi skyongaṃ*// sku tshe phrin las chab srid dpal 'byor rnams// char dus chu bo'i gter gyi rjes snyegs shog /ces dus kyi pho nya gsar tshes kyi gnam lo'i byed grub rtsis kyi li'u tho bzang ngan gzugs snang ston pa'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni rtsis rig gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i blo ldan chos 'khor sa 'dzin er ke'i nang so'i bka' lung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ gtsug lag smra ba'i gral snyegs ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sug bris su bgyis pa 'dis kyang sems can khams kyi ma rig mun pa sel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༄// mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yi ge bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags zhes bya ba la spyi'i grangs su gdengs can chu gter nam mkha' 'dren byed mchis pa las khyad par lag pa dus mtshams nas zin pa'i prāstā ras mdzes par byas pa'o//

༄༅// bimalādar+shanāmaprabhawet+yag+niḥshashas+yawar+ṣasaṃpūr+ṇaṇas+yaṛth+wasti// ༄༅// rab byung zhes pa me yos kyi gnam lo rdzogs pa'i li'u tho dri med me long zhes bya ba yod// ༄༅// sadāparaswabhāwash+tsashūn+yatā/ kadātsitāk+ṣaras+sad+mahāsukhā/ yugaṃbhashatsanirbāṇayoḥprabhuḥ sadāhikālatsakreṇapālayaṃ// ༄༅// rnam rigs rang bzhin brjod pa/ kun mchog gi rang bzhin stong nyid dang*// nam yang 'pho med dam pa'i bde ba che// zung 'jug srid dang mya ngan 'das dag gi /khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor los rtag tu skyongs// tshogs gnyis bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ chu gter gting mtha' dpag dka' ba// smon lam sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs las skyes// spangs rtogs yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa can// thub mchog nyin mor byed pa gtsug tu mchod// nyi gzhon rmad byung dpe/ 'od kyis 'khyud pa'i thun mtshams sprin// dran pas snying gi mun pa drung phyung nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros ster bzod na// 'jam dpal khyod kyi ngo mtshar rjes su byed// mchu 'dab bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i khong gsing nas// mtha' klas shes bya ma lus snyan dngags glu// rgyud mangs sgra dang bsres nas rtag 'jo ba'i// yid 'phrog tshangs pa'i bu mos mgrin par rol// thub chos 'gog pa/ mchog zhal las dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud// mnos pa'i zla bzang skal ba sbom po ru// gleng ba 'di ci de ni ston pa yi// ye shes las gzhan bskal par btsal du med// de sogs chos mtshungs gsal dpe/ kyi rgyal srid mthon po'i khrir// mnga' gsol gsang ba mchog 'dir legs byas drin// rgyu skar lam gyi mtha' la 'khu sems can// chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyi shu lnga// mkhyen cha shas gzugs can/ dpyod yangs pa'i shing rtas dus 'khor lo'i// rgyud 'grel nor bu rin thang gzhal du med// sham+bha la nas 'phags pa'i yul gyi grur// legs par 'dren pa'i paṇa chen tsi lu pa//

nang shis byed kyi rgyu/ gnas lnga'i rig pa spyi dang bye brag tu// skar nag rtsis tshul mkhas pa'i las gsum gyis// bsil ldan ljongs 'dir gsal byed rgya bod kyi// mkhas mchog yongs kyi rnam thar bsams kyin dad// mkhyen bsdus shing ma bsdus gzugs can/ dpyod lang tsho dar bab smin legs mas// thams cad mkhyen rgyu rig pa'i 'gram chang gis// bdag blo'i ba ku la de kha 'byed pa'i// mkhas mchog zhabs rdul gtsug tu nyer blangs nas// rab cha shas can gyi gzugs can/ byung gnam lo gsar du tshes pa 'dir// dbang sgyur sa yi bdag po gza' skar sogs// ji bzhin ston pa'i byed grub rtsis dag gi /li'u tho'i me long dwangs pa 'di na ngom// grong gseb snying rje'i nyams/ blun po rang nyid 'grangs ltogs kyi// tshad kyang nges par zin pa brgya lam 'gas// zog rdzun lung gi kha khral smra ba la// thal sbyar btud pa'i bgyi ba da thongs shig /bskal bzang sems dpa' kun las dang po'i sems// bskyed pa'i snying stobs mchog gis snyigs ma 'dir// mngon par 'tshang rgya'i smon lam yi ge'i mchog /bris de rjes su dran pas dam pa tog /'dzam bu ljon pas mtshon pa'i gling 'di na// gzigs pa rnam lngas gnyis las 'thung ba'i dbang*// mche ba drug ldan tshul gyis sgyu 'phrul ma'i// lhums su zhugs nas zla ba bcu rdzogs par// drag po lcags sprel sa ga zla ba yi// dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis par lum+bi nīr// ngo mtshar bye ba'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu// bltams nas ri mkha' ri mig sngon du brgal// dpa' bo lcags 'brug nag nyar gsang ba'i bdag /sa dbang zol gyis 'gro 'dul zla bzang sogs// skal bzang 'gro ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dbus// rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po dus 'khor lo'i// rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bdud rtsi stsal nas lo// ri bo 'khrig pa ro dang 'dren byed

26 brgal/ 27 /shing sprel dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du// chu skyes ze'u 'brur pad+ma sam+bha wa// zhing 'di'i gdul bya 'bras bu'i theg pa yis// yang dag lam la bkri phyir brdzus skyes su// 'khrungs nas me mig 26 dus 23 dang 'khrig pa 'das// shing byir ma hā tsi na'i yid can rnams// kun rdzob bden pas 'dul gzigs 'jam pa'i dpal// ri bo rtse lngar tri k+ṣa'i shing lba las// brdzus te 'bru mar sgron me ltar bltams nas// bgrang gzhi rtse mo klu dang de nyid 'das// shing khyir bod rje yongs kyi gtsug tor tog /chos kyi rgyal po lha gcig tho tho ri// mgon bral 'gro ba'i gnyen du 'khrungs nas lo// me dang bu ga chu bo zla ba 14 93 'das// chu mo sbrul lor gangs can 'gro ba spyi'i// bsod nams gser gyi shing rta yangs pa ru// dam pa'i chos skal sngon ma za ma tog /babs shing bstan pa snga dar dbu brnyes nas// bgrang gzhi mtsho dang zla ba ma 14 14 nu brgal// lcags glang 'jam dpal gyis gsungs spor thang rtsis// legs nyes 'bras bu ston pa'i ā dar+shaḥ// thugs rje myur ma dpa' mo'i sgyu 'phrul gyi// rang gzugs tshangs pa'i yid kyis bris 'dra ba// 'un shing kong jos bsnams shing pur rgyal bod// bsod nams mgron du khugs nas bgrang ba'i gzhi// dus dang nam mkha' 1106 drag po sngon du song*// sa lug sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan che// mthon por bsgreng la 'jigs pa med pa'i mthu// grangs med skye ba'i smon lam gyis byin pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po zla 'od gzhun nu de// ngo mtshar bye ba'i ltas bcas bltams nas lo// gdengs can ro dang dus kyi grang 668 sa 'das so// lcags stag shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung*// mgrin las yang dag 'jo bas thub pa'i bstan// phyogs bral kun du rab gsal byed pa'i blo// 'jam dpal gzhon nus legs byin 'dren pa mchog

/zas gtsang sras ltar 'khrungs nas bgrang ba'i gzhi// me klu sngon du brgal ba'i gsar tshes lo// rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur legs sbyar ba'i// brda sprod lha yi skad du pra bha wa// mngon brjod 'bum phrag gsum par rab byung dang*// tsi na'i rgyal khab chen por tang ma 'u// ljongs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun me yos zhes// 'byung ba sum ldan se zhig zla ba'i klung*// pho brang gling dgu'i dbus su gcig dkar zhugs// rnam dag grub pa'i lo gza' bsil zer can// lo yi skar ma sna tshogs lha ldan ma// bsdus rgyud byed pa'i lo 'pho snyan dngags mkhan// lo stod dbang sgyur rgyal po snang ba'i gter// bka' yi 'phrul blon chen po mdza' lha'i grogs// rin chen gaṇ+ḍa yangs pa'i rdul gyi khrod// lo ha'i smyig gu zlos pa'i gar bsgyur las// bzang ngan 'bras bu 'phrin du shong byed pa'i// ming tshig yi ge'i phreng ba bsgrigs 'dir ltos// rab byung lo 'dir sprin sngon mkhar mdzes shing*// char gyi rgyun 'bab lo legs zhes 'byung yang*// mdo sde gsang bar char 'bring bra sran bzang*// dkar mo brtson la nad rims khre'u dang*// skye bo mi srun dmag 'khrug 'byung zhes gleng*// grub pa'i lo gza' (18) char dang chu klung che// ri klung nags tshal me tog gis mdzes shing*// lo legs sman gyi ro nus mchog tu bskyed// bzhon las 'o ma mang 'jo gzhon nu bde// mi bdag byams pa'i stobs kyis yul 'khor skyong*// lo skar (20) 'bras bu yul kun char mi snyoms// 'gro ba dge sdig 'dres ma'i las la sbyor// byed pa lo bdag (6) 'bras bu rgyal rigs bzang*// byis pa bder btsa' 'dron ba lam du dge /tshong pa zong gis dga' 'gyur rin chen 'phel// 'gro lus bro nad med pa'i bdud rtsi 'thung*// lo stod dbang sgyur (1) rgyal por char pa chung*// rtsi shing lo thog dman par srog chags 'tshe// phyugs la nad 'byung snang byed 'od zer 'bri// skya rgyal 'khrug pa bdo zhing dmangs rigs bde// lo smad 'phrul

(4) blon 'bras bu char chu rgyas// lo thog snye ma smin pa'i khur gyis mdzes// rgyal po 'bangs dang byis pa rje'u rigs bde// mkhas pa'i blo dang bzhon rnams 'o ma 'phel// dgu (1) gling dbus zhugs rims dang 'khrug pa 'byung*// dag byed rgyun che yul 'pho mi 'bru snyi// bal yul mkhas pa'i mngon shes me long las// zad pa rab la dri gzhon 'khrug pa dang*// 'bru tshogs 'bring la char 'phel 'bring gi smad// rtswa ljang bsil drod reg pa tha ma'o// sha ka'i lo tshogs drag pos sbyangs pa'i lhag /thig shar char pa zhod ces gleng ba sogs// 'bras bu bzang ngan spel mar 'byung ba'i phyir// mtha' gcig 'chel pa'i stong gcod smra dka' yang*// bung bas pad+ma'i bcud bsdus sbrang rtsi ltar// kun gyi snying po 'bring stod tsam du gzung*// pra 'phrul dpa' ba'i nyams ldan/ mkhas pa'i sngags kyis ma btab cing*// thun gsum yur du rmi lam bsgugs min par// gsar tshes gnam lo'i bzang dman lkog na mo// mchid du gleng ba'i spobs pa thob 'di ci/ 'gyod pas 'gog pa/ 'byung 'gyur 'bras bu lung du ston 'di la// bden nam rdzun zhes 'ga' zhig bshung srid kyang*// tshad mar gyur pa rnams kyi gsung don las// rang dgar byas pa med phyir bdag mi 'gyod// tshul gzugs can gyis spud pa'i rigs pa'i rgyu/ 'dir 'bad pa'i legs byas ke ta kas// lus can rmongs pa'i chu rnyog bgrungs pa'i nang*// phyi nang gzhan gsum shes bya'i ngo mtshar gzugs// ston mdzad chos kyi rgyal po mngon gyur shog /ces pa me yos kyi gnam lo rdzogs pa'i le'u tho dri med me long zhes bya ba'i gong bshad 'di'ang rang dang tshe bh+rūṃ bla ma o rgyan pa'i ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga la bha wa tu// // ༄// mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta skye 'gro la prāstā ra bzhi stong rjes 'brangs bcas/

yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba bcu gnyis rjes 'brangs bcas/ yi ge bzhi khri rjes 'brangs bcas/ lci yang so so nyi khri rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo bdun khri rjes 'brangs bcas/ a dh+wa 'phred re mig steng 'og brgyad stong rjes 'brangs bcas/ khyad par ud+diṣ+ṭa chig stong rjes 'brangs bcas/ naṣ+ṭa re pha bzhi pa gzhung gis dngos bstan me tog phreng ba zhes bya bas mdzes par byas pa'o// ༄༅// puṇ+ḍarīkapuṣ+keranāmām+bumarkaṭawar+ṣas+yakarasid+dhogaṇitoraṛth+wasti// ༄༅// chu sprel lo'i byed grub rtsis kyi le'u tho pad dkar rdzing bu zhes bya ba yod// ༄// dhar+m+madhātuḥprapañtsash+tsanan+tapṛyābikṛḍebhiḥpraṇītas+sukhānāṃrasaṃ/ māritodhātushān+tobhawāriyugaukālatsakreṇahepālayashrīguruḥ/ ༄// chos dbyings spros pa'i mtha' bral dga' ma dang*// gya nom bde ba'i ro la rnam rtsen pas// srid zhi'i dgra bo zung 'jug dbyings su bsad// dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor los skyongs// grangs med bskal pa'i thugs bskyed g.yar dam gyi// yi ge dam pa thugs kar legs bkod pa// lus med dpung gis bsub tu med pa la// bsngags pa'i me tog gis gtor thub pa'i dbang*// ye shes snang ba rnon po khams gsum gyi// rmongs pa gcod la mkhas gyur 'jam dpal dbyangs// phyag na ral gris mtshan pas ci zhig bya// de mthu khyod la med snyam 'phyang mo nyug /bsil zer byed pa bdag gi mtshar sdug rnams// thub chod rtsom pa 'dis ni phrogs so zhes// dpal ldan tshangs pa'i bu mo'i thor tshugs rtser// mdzes byed zol gyis lhags nas blta ba snyam// rgyal gsung chos kyis mtho ba'i khri 'phang du// rtsa lag 'tsho ltar dmar ba'i zhabs bkod cing*// skal bzang skye bo smin cing grol byed pa'i// sa dbang bdun dang rigs ldan nyi shu lnga// rgyud 'grel kā shi mdzes dga'i bzhin gyi zla// mkhyen dpyod me long dwangs pa'i mkha' dbyings su// 'gog med shar ba tsi lu pa la sogs// 'phags bod mkhas pa'i rgyu skar bkrag tu che// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ba srid pa 'dir// rnam par dpyod ldan kunaṃ dgaṃ'i zlos gar du// mdo sngags dgongs pa'i snyingaṃ poṃ zab rgya che// yang dag 'doms pa'i rgyal po sa skya pa// mi mchog tshangs pa'i dbyangs las nga yi chos// dri med smra ba'i skyes bu kunaṃ dgaṃ'i dpal// skyed byed skal ba bzaṃng poṃ 'di'o zhes// bsngags pa'i 'phrin yig drug skyes glu las snyan// bde sdug 'bras bu 'byin la 'jug ldog gi

/gnad 'gag ji bzhin gsal ba rig pa'i mig /gtsug lag spor thang rtsis dang dbyangs 'char rgyud// 'chad pa'i mchu 'dab snyung ba gang yin dang*// sngon goms legs byas dag byed gter gyi bcud// rgyal bstan pad+ma bzhad pa'i rtsa lag tu// sprul pa'i zlos gar gang de rdo rje'i khrir// 'gyur med shis pa'i mkha' dkyil brtan gyur cig /dbyangs ldan gyis rtsen mgrin pa'i 'khor lo las// thubaṃ bstanaṃ rabaṃ gsaṃl byed pa rig pa'i gzhung*// mtha' klas rtag tu 'jo ba chu yi gter// dag byed bye ba'i 'byung gnas rjes su byed// snyom las mal du rnam dpyod mig 'dzums shing*// mong rtul gnyid la yur bdag rig pa'i gnas// che chung ltad mo ngo mtshar ngom pa por// skal bas thob pa kun la phyag byas nas// mtha' klas shes bya ma lus grangs kyi gnas// 'char ba rig pa'i 'phrul 'di ston pa la// dbyangs ldan lus phra 'dri byed smyu gu'i tshul// rin chen gaṇ+ḍa yangs par gar gyis brel// gang tshe gnam gyi lo 'dir dbang sgyur ba'i// bdag po rje blon gza' dang rgyu skar sogs// rnam gsal byed grub rtsis kyi li'u tho'i rdzing*// blo gsal lang tsho ldan pa'i 'jug ngogs 'dri// bskal bzang sems dpa' stong las dang po'i thugs// bskyed pa'i snying stobs mchog gis snyigs ma lnga'i// dus 'dir 'tshang rgya bgyid pa'i smon lam srog /mi shigs cho ga grub pa dam pa tog /dga' ba dang ldan chos kyi khang bzangs nas// 'dzam bu rkang 'thung gis mtshan gling dam par// gshegs pa'i nyer bsdogs gzigs pa rnam pa lngas// thal kar gnyis las 'thung mchog rnam pa yis// tshangs pa'i yid kyis bris 'dra sgyu 'phrul ma'i// lhums su zhugs nas zla ba bcu rdzogs pa'i// drag po lcags sprel sa ga zla ba yi// dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis par yid srubs kyis// sprul pa'i longs spyod lum+bi nī yi tshal// 'od kyi pho nya dang po'i 'phrin shod bzhin// bltams pa nas bzung nyi ma ri mig 'das// shing rta me tog ldan pa'i bco lnga la// byang chub ljon pa'i drung na mi phyed pa// rdo rje'i rang bzhin skyil mo krung bcas te// bdud sde'i dpung chen sbrul gdug kha yi rlangs// byams chen sman gyi rgyal pos rab bcil te// byang chub bla med brnyes pa'i tshul bstan nas// bgrang gzhi nor lha thub pa dus mig 'das// rnam par gnon pa lcags 'brug nag pa'i nyar// lho phyogs 'bras so spungs pa'i mchod rten cher// dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po mi bdag gi

/sgyu 'phrul rnam rol chos rgyal zla bzang la// mchog gi dang po rtsa rgyud bdud rtsi'i sgo// legs par phye nas so dang dus mig brgal// shing sprel dha na ko sha'i chu gter gling*// 'dab stong ze'u 'brur pad+ma sam+bha waḥ// brdzus te 'khrungs nas ri bo mig dus 'khrig /shing byi ma hā tsi na'i yul gyi mi// kun rdzob rtsis kyi bden pas 'dul gzigs nas// ri bo rtse lnga tri k+ṣa shing lba las// 'jam dpal mgon po bus pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// 'bru mar sgron me lta bur bltams nas klu// nor lha de nyid sngon 'das shing pho khyir// bho ṭa'i yul gyi chos rgyal yongs mes po// tho tho ri gnyan 'khrungs nas bgrang ba'i gzhi// klu bug ma nu brgal ba'i chu mo sbrul// lha de'i bsod nams yangs pa'i gser snod du// dam chos seng dkar sgeg mo'i 'o ma nyid// 'khyil pa'i thog ma brnyes nas bug zla yid// sa glang gangs ldan skye bo 'dul ba la// rjes chags spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan rje// mngon par bltams nas me zung drag po'i lo// lcags glang thugs rje myur ma dpa' mo'i zla// srid pa'i mtsho nang 'phos pa'i 'jo sgeg gis// 'jig rten dge legs bye ba'i brtan pa dag /rang dbang 'gugs byed 'un shing kong jo yis// spor thang rtsis kyi mngon shes ma gu ra// bsnams nas kha ba ri pa'i bsod nams kyi// mgron du khugs nas bse ru drag po zla// chu glang bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje'i gdan// lha ldan 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang btab nas// bug gter phyogs 'das rab byung thog ma'i lor// 'phags yul bden don yan lag bcu gnyis kyi// khyab bdag kā la tsakra spyan drangs nas// 'byung mtshams ri bo sngon 'das me stag lo// stong par zhugs nas rab byung me yos mgo /zugs nas gsang chen snying po dus 'khor lo// gangs can ljongs pa'i legs byas shing rta yis// legs par drangs nas dbang lag ri bo'i grangs// chu glang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams che// theg chen chos kyi sgra brgyas bskul ba'i mod// dbus gyur 'chang gi sa stengs rgyan nyid du// 'phos pa min nam snyam pa dpal sa skya'i// chos grwa chen po btab nas zla ba'i mdzod// bu ga thub pa ro 'das chu pho sprel// 'phags pa phyag na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lha// rnam 'dren bstan la rjes su chags pa'i gzugs// bsil ldan mkhas pa'i rgyan gyur sa skya pa// kun dga' snying po bltams nas mkha' ro mtshams// lcags stag mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur// dpal ldan phag mo grub par grags pa'i rnga// phyogs bral mkhas pa'i rnar snyan 'khrungs nas lo// 'khrig pa chu gter dus rnams sngon du 'das// 'jam dpal gzhon nu lnga rig mkhas tshul gyi// skye bar zlos pa'i gar gyis rgyal bstan la// rnam dag las byas sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// 'khrungs nas nam mkha' ri bo mda' yi grangs// chu glang 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa'i zhabs// bsod nams gnam gyi mthongs nas bskos pa'i lha// gong ma se chen rgyal po'i rigs kyi bdag

/spyan 'dren mdzad nas bod yul chol kha gsum// dbang yon phul sogs bla chen sa skya pa// bod khams yongs kyi phan bde'i byed po ru// mnga' gsol mdzad nas gter dang bu ga mtsho// me mo bya lor mdo smad btsong kha ru// blo ster 'jam dpal gzhon nu chos 'dul gyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan slong ba blo bzang grags// skye ba'i sdong bu bzung nas 'byung gter me// rnga chen chu khyir nyi ma'i gnyen mchog gi /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i me long ngos shar ba'i// lung du bstan pa tam+bu ra yi sgras// rab bsngags skyes bu tshad ma e waṃ pa// kun dga' bzang po bltams nas bug mtshams me// rgyu 'bras theg pa dam pa'i 'khor lo ni// mi nub rtag par bskor ba'i chos grwa che// e waṃ chos ldan btab nas bgrang ba'i gzhi// chu bo lag pa rtse mo'i grangs su song*// me rtar 'jam pa'i rdo rje ye shes kyi// sgyu 'phrul rgyal ba'i myu gur zlos pa'i zla// gsang gsum yon tan bsil ba'i zer phreng gis// lnga rig bstan pa'i ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal// karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal zhabs// tshe bh+rūm̐ gnas su bltams nas mtshams dang klu// chu rtar rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems// gdul bya'i mos par 'tsham pa'i lam ston phyir// thun mtshams lang tsho gsar pas bklubs pa'i gar// sa gsum mdzes byed dpaṃl ldanaṃ bla ma'i mchog /chosaṃ tshul skyongaṃ ba'i rgyal po bltams nas lo// nam mkha' dbang po'i grangs kyang sngon du brgal// deng dus srid pa 'di yi mngon sprul pa'i// yid 'phrog dpyid dus lang tsho dar bab mas// dro 'jam lag pa'i g.yab mo stong phrag gis// mgron du gnyer byas gnam lo'i mdza' na mo// gang la rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur brda// legs sbyar lha yi skad du aṅki raḥ// stod 'grel las ni legs sbyar sor bzhag nyid// dbang phyogs gnam gyi mthongs nas bskos pa'i lha// mi bdag rgyal po'i khab tu zhin shing dang*// bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir dbang thang gi

/khams dang rjes mthun chu pho sprel du 'bod// 'byung ba bzhi ldan se zhig mig dmar klung*// pho brang dgu gling lte bar 'khor los sgyur// dgra lha'i me long chen pos rnam par rtsen// rnam dag grub pa'i lo gza' tshim byed skyes// gnam lo'i rgyu skar mgo las skyes pa'i bu// byed pa'i rtsis tshul ri mo'i lam nyid du// legs par shar ba'i lo gza' pa wa sangs// lo stod dbang sgyur rgyal po bdud rtsi'i zer// de yi 'phrul blon lha yi bla ma'o// a ho don dam bden ngor chos rnams kun// bya byed las kyi spros mthar lhung min yang*// kun rdzob snang bar lo gza' rgyu skar sogs// 'jam rtsub 'bras bu 'byin pa rten 'brel chos// lkog gyur 'bras bu brjod par dka' ba'i gzhu// yid ches lung gi rgyud du bkug pa las// 'phos pa'i lung bstan tshig gi nyag phran 'dis// 'phyang mo nyug gi bden bral mgo bo bregs// de yang aṅki ra zhes gsar tshes kyi// lo 'dir phyugs la nad 'byung lo tog legs// yul 'ga' 'khrug la 'ga' zhig bde'o zhes// bha ra ha mis lung bstan me long bshad// grub pa'i lo gza'i 'bras bu gru char che// lo thog legs 'byung mkhal mar bro yang 'tshal// rje rigs mi bdag 'bangs dang byis pa bde// dpyod ldan blo dang bzhon ma'i 'o ma 'phel// dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis par brda sprod mkhan// 'byung ba'i 'gros kyis rgyu skar zla ba skyes// chu tshod yon tan rjes 'brangs bcas pa la// longs su spyad pas char dkon rgyal po rtsod// cung zad skya 'pham sgo nga las skyes dang*// rir gnas srog chags 'tshe ba mang zhes gleng*// byed pa lo bdag 'bras bu rgyal rigs rgyal// 'dron pa lam dge tshong zong rin chen 'phel// lus stobs rnam par nyams pa'i bro mi 'tshal// byis pa gdon gyis 'tshe ba med par btsa'// lo stod rgyal po zla bas dbang byas tshe// char gyi rgyun 'bab chu klung lteng ka 'phel// nags tshal me tog stobs bdo lo legs 'byung*// bzhon ma rnams las 'o ma mang 'jo zhing*// mi bdag byams pa'i rlan ldan 'bangs la byams// lang tsho dar bab skyid pa'i gar gyis rtsen// de yi 'phrul blon phur bus mchod sbyin dang*// rnam 'byed blo dang chos ldan grags pa spel// 'jig rten lhas skyong sbrang char dus su 'bebs// rtsi shing 'bru dang rta phyugs stobs 'phel byed// ṛ ṣi lha yi bla ma'i bstan bcos las// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i lo legs 'bru tshogs dang*// longs spyod rgyas pa'i dga' ston gyis myos pa'i// skye bo thams cad skyid pa'i ga zha 'byin// ma hā tsi na'i mdo sde gsang ba las// 'di lo nam zla'i stod then nam smad zhod// ju tse rgyal 'gyur 'bras dang so ba brtson// khre dang gnag rnams legs 'byung mtha' 'khob yul// bkres rngabs dang ldan chu lha'i phyogs kyang 'khrug

/bsod nams tshogs kyi bgyi ba bzang zhes gleng*// bcu gnyis lo 'bras phal cher snga mkho las// ston 'bring char zhod yang na ser ba rgod// so zar brtson la gro nas 'bring po dang*// skya ni rgyal 'gyur mi 'bru snyi bar bstan// gzhan yang stag rna chung ngur dkar nag gi /lo legs shis pa min pa 'byung yang smra// lnga ser rgyal po dbus zhugs chos mdzad la// cung zad ngan 'gyur rgyal po dmangs kyis 'bebs// lo nyes 'byung sogs 'bras bu dman tsam dang*// bal yul mkhas pa'i legs bshad ka ra'i bcud// myangs pa'i tshor ba 'khrug dang zad pa char// rtswa sngon rab yin 'bru rlung 'phel ba 'bring*// bsil dang drod kyis gdung ba tha ma'o// sha ka'i 'das lor dbang phyug sbyangs pa'i lhag /yon tan grangs su shar bas yul gru kun// yid 'phrog sprin gyi rnga yab kyis gtor ba'i// sbrang char zegs ma'i dga' ston ci yang 'gyed// de sogs 'bras bu bzang ngan mtha' gcig tu// ma nges rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar bkra yang*// kun gyi snying po bsdoms pa srid pa'i dpal// thams cad 'bring stod tsam zhig 'byung snyam byed// chu sprel lo yi kā shi mdzes dga' ma'i// bzhin ras zla ba rgyas pa'i zer 'thungs pas// snod bcud dge legs lang tsho dar gud kyi// lung bstan snyan dngags dam pa'i 'phrin du bsnyad// nor bu'i gaṇ+ḍa yangs pa'i rdul khrod du// tshul chen zung gi bsgyur bgod ri mo la// lkog gyur shes bya'i dngos po rjen 'char de// blta phyir dbang pos mig stong sprul lam snyam// lang tsho rab rgyas khu byug bu mo'i glu// dus su len pa mnyan pa'i 'os yin mod// sna tshogs bza' ba yid byed gzhan gsos su// ca co rnam par 'byin la de lta min// tshul 'di 'bad pa'i legs byas stobs bcu pa'i// bstan pa skye dgu yongs kyi phan bde'i gzhi// grangs med smra ba mkhas pa'i bshad sgrub kyi// sgra dbyangs srid pa'i rtse mor lud gyur cig

/zur gyis blta dang rus pa'i ke sa ra// 'dzum dkar zer gyis mi bsu na yang deng*// mang thos snying gi brtan pa yongs dbrog pa// thabs shes yi ges mtshan bstan rgyas gyur cig /bod khams yangs pa'i legs bris rdzing bu la// bde 'byor lo legs pad+ma rgyas pa'i nang*// grangs med lus can chu yi gnyis skyes dag /kun dga' gsar pa'i 'phur lding bsgyur bar shog /'byung 'dus lus kyi stobs dang bde ba srog /'phrog byed gshin rje glal ba'i lci 'dra ba// nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa ngan pa rnams// sgron ma bteg pa'i mun ltar zhi gyur cig /gang la sbyangs pas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi// shes bya'i gnas la rmongs pa ring spong ba// thams cad mkhyen lam reg pa'i tshul 'di la// srid pa kun tu bdag blo gsal gyur cig /de skad gnam lo chu khams kyi// yal ga'i ri dwags mtshan ldan pa'i// li'u tho'i pad dkar rdzing bu 'di// bde gshegs sras kyi bslab bya ba// gtsug lag 'di ko don gnyer can// smyug thogs bstan 'dzin mchog grub dang*// shākya chos 'phel zung gi ngor// rjes 'jug 'gar yang phan snyam du// ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis// lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris// // ༄༅// rnga chen gyi gnam lo'i dgun zla rwa bar zla ba gzas 'dzin gyi ri mo shar ba'i sgo yig yod// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i nyi zla dag /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi// sgra gcan kha ru za byed pa'i// bla ma dus kyi 'khor lor 'dud// gnam lo mkha' ro'i grangs mnyam las// rgyun ldan ma des bskyed pa'i bu// ku ku ra zhes bod pa yi// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ci yang ngom// de nang ma drug las skyes pa'i// kārti ka yis nya ba'i zla// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dga' ston la// spyod pa'i rdzogs pa gsum pa der// rgyu skar bdag po sgra gcan gyi// gdong dang phrad pa'i ri mo dag

/gaṇ+ḍa yangs pa'i bzhin ras su// shar ba'i ngo mtshar ltad mo byung*// de yi bshad tshul rang gzhan gzhung*// mang po'i lung las blangs pa'i mchid// rdzogs par gleng bar byed pa na// blo ldan phur bu yin yang ngal// 'on te 'di na thog ma yi// mgon po dus kyi 'khor lo las// dngos bstan phyi nang gzhan gsum las// phyi ltar sbyar ba'i tshul bshad na// mkha' dang 'dres pa'i sgra gcan lus// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin des// dngos po gzhan dag sgrib byed na// dngos po'i chos nyid ci ste rung*// 'on kyang de yi gdong mjug dag /bai ḍūr+ya yi rang bzhin can// gang phrad pa yi mun grib kyis// sgrib pa kun rdzob bden pa'i chos// des na nyin mtshan chu tshod las// nyer gsum rnam par brgal ba'i tshe// ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor cha// bcu phrag gzhan du zegs pa bzhin// sgra gcan gdong gi zhugs nang du// lan brgyar bzhu ba'i zangs kyi tshon// yang yang byugs pa ji bzhin du// chu tshod brgyad kyi yun tsam sgrib// nang ltar 'gro ba'i lus kyi rtsa// a wa dhū tī'i rtse mo'i haṃ// rkyang mar 'brel pa i ḍa'i khams// kha sbyor phyi ru zla ba 'dzin// gzhan du bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor lus// rkyang mar gnas pa'i dri bzhon de// a wa dhū tī'i dbang byas tshe// nang du mngon 'tshang rgya bar bshad// de tshe sgo gsum 'bad pa yi// rnam dkar dge ba gang bsags dang*// rim gnyis bsgom dang bzlas pa yi// 'bras bu bye ba bdun 'gyur gsungs// bslu med tshad ma'i skyes bu yis// legs par gsungs pa'i rjes 'jug dag /'di nyin mchod dang sbyin gtong sogs// rtse gcig dge la 'bad par zhu// de skad smras pa'i dge ba des// sems can kun gyi ma rig pa'i// gdung ba kun nas sel byed pa'i// ye shes zla ba nyid gyur cig /ces pa rnga chen gyi gnam lo'i dgun zla rwa bar zla 'dzin 'byung ba'i ri mo shar ba sgo yig tu dgram byar tshigs su bcad pa bris shig ces/

sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i bka' stsal phebs 'phral/ rtsis rig 'chang ba'i gzugs brnyan pa tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa'o// // ༄༅// na tshod ldan gyi gnam lo'i spo zlar zla ba sgra gcan phrad pa'i 'phrin yig yod// ༄༅// oṃ swasti bi dza yan+tu/ dus gsum dus bral yongs gzigs nas// dus su 'dzol med nyid 'doms pa// dus gsum rgyal gzugs bla ma dang*// dus kyi 'khor lor nyer btud de// na tshod dar ldan bgrang ba'i gzhir// sgrol byed lha mo dbos nya ba'i// gang ba'i phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum// dus kyi kun phan dkyil 'khor che// stobs chen seng ge mo bu yi// gdong me'i dkyil 'khor mnyam phrad dus// mtshan mo nyer brgyad sngon brgal bar// grags pa'i mu khyud gnas phyogs nas// sum cha gcig lhag tsam gyi tshon// sngo nag rgya skyegs kyis bkab pas// chu tshon drug yun mtshar sdug gi /cha shas 'phrog pa'i 'phrin shod la// rgyu skar tshogs kyang brel 'gyur gyi// ri mor mkhas pa'i zlos gar stong*// gaṇ+ḍa'i do ra yangs pa'i nang*// bsgyur ba bsdus rgyud rjes 'brangs gleng*// 'bras bu drag gza' sgra mkhan de// myur 'gro'i khams ldan lha mo khwas// mgron du bkug pas 'dzom min yang*// zhag re'i grangs su gnam dus brtag /'di nyin mchod sbyin rnam dkar las// rim gnyis bsgom bzlas brtson pa'i dge /bye ba bdun 'gyur bslu med gsungs// gang phyir dge tshogs lhur len 'tshal// de skad mchid 'di rtsis rig pa// slob bu lhun grub phun tshogs ngor// btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis// la gor chos sde pho brang bris// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
